body.name: Wang-compatible full-data class
body.construction: The Wang-compatible class \(\mathcal F_W(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\) consists of full-data laws satisfying Wang Assumption 3.1: the displayed event-time consistency condition, pointwise treatment overlap, treatment exchangeability \(T(a)\perp\!\!\!\perp A\mid X\), and pointwise censoring overlap, while inducing the observed law \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\) and obeying \(0\le T(a)\le t_{\max}\). No continuity, monotonicity, finite-Lipschitz, or independent-censoring restriction is imposed. The completion proof uses laws with a full potential-censoring representation as a smaller witness subclass; converse attainment by that subclass transfers upward to the published Wang class.
